accessNotes:
MAJOR CAVEAT ON PRICING. The live checkout is JS-gated: https://alphacapitalgroup.uk/ renders its price widget as 'Total due: One-time payment $0.00' and https://app.alphacapitalgroup.uk/FundingEvaluationPayments/89 returns only the heading 'Alpha Capital' with no DOM content. The /product page lists plan NAMES only and states 'Evaluation fees start from $50 on the smallest Alpha One tier and scale with simulated account size' without a table. Therefore NO price in this capture was read off a live checkout. All prices come from Alpha Capital's OWN editorial page https://alphacapitalgroup.uk/posts/how-much-does-a-prop-firm-evaluation-cost-2026, which self-reports 'Page Last Updated: June 1, 2026' - i.e. ~8 weeks stale as of 2026-07-27, and that page itself says to 'Confirm the price on product page'. Treat all priceUsd values as firm-published-but-unverified-against-checkout.

PRICE CONFLICT (unresolved): https://alphacapitalgroup.uk/resources/alpha-capital-review-2026-trader-verdict states 'Alpha Pro 25K (2-step): $197', while the cost page states 'Alpha Pro 25K 6% $25,000 $137'. These are two different pages on the same official domain disagreeing. Most likely explanation is that the $197 figure refers to a Pro 8% or 10% variant, but the firm does not say so. I did NOT resolve this and did NOT average it. Alpha Pro prices below are recorded ONLY for the 6% variant, as explicitly labelled on the cost page.

NO PRICE TABLE EXISTS on any official page for Alpha Pro 8%, Alpha Pro 10%, Alpha Swing (except a single 100K data point), or Alpha Direct. The cost page explicitly defers: 'Alpha Pro is also available at 8% and 10% Phase 1 targets, and Alpha Swing supports overnight holds - each with different fees per size on /product.' Those are left null.

VARIANT/PRICE MAPPING AMBIGUITY: Alpha One ships in 6%, 10% and 12% variants with DIFFERENT rules (see help centre article 10097421). The price table rows are labelled only 'Alpha One 5K', 'Alpha One 10K' etc. with no variant suffix, so it is NOT knowable which variant those prices buy. The rule figures recorded under the Alpha One product below are the 10% variant (the one the firm's own rules blog presents as the headline spec). Do not assume the listed prices correspond to the 10% variant.

PAYOUT FREQUENCY CONFLICT (unresolved): help centre 'Performance fee bi-weekly' says bi-weekly is 'available on Alpha Pro/Three accounts', but the homepage and the rules blog both advertise 'Bi-Weekly or On-Demand' for Alpha One. I recorded the narrower help-centre position. Flagged rather than resolved.

MAX TRADING DAYS: no time limit is published on any page read, for any plan. Recorded as null everywhere rather than as 'unlimited'.

No geo-blocking encountered. help.alphacapitalgroup.uk and app.alphacapitalgroup.uk are subdomains of the firm's own domain and were treated as official.
